verdict.rationale: Claude Code's first-party MCP docs say it connects to external tools through MCP. They give a concrete `claude mcp add --transport http` command and describe both remote HTTP servers and local stdio servers, with usage examples such as Jira, Slack and PostgreSQL. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of MCP client usage, and detail on configuration scopes and limits in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Claude Code can connect to hundreds of external tools and data sources through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
claude mcp add --transport http notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp
Stdio servers run as local processes on your machine. They're ideal for tools that need direct system access or custom scripts.
With MCP, Claude Code can read your design docs in Google Drive, update tickets in Jira, pull data from Slack, or use your own custom tooling.
